findings.finding: On a first beat, weight_read_request_valid depends combinationally on psum_read_request_ready while psum_read_request_valid depends combinationally on weight_read_request_ready. The truth table makes the two fires atomic only after the Boolean network settles, but the frozen contract does not require either external sink to generate ready independently of valid. A legal valid-dependent-ready pair can therefore form a combinational loop with no fixed point.
findings.impact: The current wrapper is not a composable ready/valid source. A friendly static test or sink with constant ready can pass while an integrated service deadlocks or oscillates. VCS and DC launch are stopped before this interface is repaired.

findings.finding: The wrapper permits one outstanding service transaction and cannot accept a new request in the same cycle that the prior joined response is consumed. With a one-cycle response, request and issue-data accepts have a minimum II of two, whereas frozen M935 can expose a new beat after every accepted issue. No frozen external latency or joint RTL recurrence proves this serialization is the M1114 raw CPU coordinate.
findings.impact: Even after functional repair, this boundary cannot inherit 1.7591725402x or any prior cycle result. A matched address-timed replay is mandatory; if II=2 remains, it must be charged to all reported candidate cycles.

sticky_fault_review.reason: Frozen M935 retains active_ctx and issue_request_valid until the joined issue_data_valid/issue_data_ready acceptance. Reset clears both sides. The expression is a cancellation guard, not the current blocker.

minimum_repair: Create an additive successor wrapper; do not overwrite M1116C or frozen M935.

Remove all request-valid dependence on either external ready. Use a formally specified atomic bundled service, or latch the request and track independent weight/psum request acceptance without duplicate issue.
Freeze request and response latency rules, payload stability, early-response behavior, outstanding depth, cancellation/reset behavior and whether ready may depend on valid.
Add a bounded protocol TB/SVA that covers independent request stalls, both partial-accept orders, early and skewed responses, payload hold, reset while pending, spurious response, and backpressure.
Measure accepted-request and issue-data II. Do not cite raw CPU cycles unless a matched joint replay with the frozen service model reproduces them.
Have a fresh different author hammer the repaired source before any VCS or DC authorization.
